boundary.description: From the junction of Wensley Road and Buncer Lane, along Wensley Road, Garden Street, Bank Top, Whalley Banks, King Street, Astley Gate, Church Street and Railway Street to Blackburn Station; then south easterly by the railway line to Darwen Bridge and along Great Bolton Street and Bolton Road to its junction with and N along Aqueduct Road, then W along Leeds and Liverpool Canal (opposite Amberwood Drive), then N to and along St Francis Road, Preston Old Road to its junction with an unnamed road N of river Darwen, and by a beeline to the junction of Buncer Lane and Wensley Road.
